design_philosophy: Modern, clean, professional, and trust-inspiring. Highly conversion-optimized with clear spatial hierarchy, generous padding, and high-contrast typographic pairings.

tailwind_classes.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tighter text-slate-900 leading-tight
tailwind_classes.label: text-sm font-bold tracking-[0.1em] uppercase text-slate-500

layout_and_spacing.container: container mx-auto px-6 sm:px-8 lg:px-12 max-w-7xl

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200
header.elements: Logo (BGD-Trans), Nav links, Language Switcher (RO/EN/DE), CTA Button (Orange)

hero.title: Transport persoane și colete România – Germania – Austria – Olanda
hero.subtitle: Curse regulate tur-retur. Siguranță, confort și punctualitate.

services_section.card_style: bg-white rounded-2xl border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all duration-300 group
services_section.image_hover: w-full h-full object-cover group-hover:scale-105 transition-transform duration-700

routes_section.style: bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-3xl p-8 sm:p-12 my-12
routes_section.layout: Visual stepper or multi-column grid displaying the route: Romania -> Germany -> Austria -> Netherlands with city lists.

booking_form.wrapper: bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl border border-slate-100 p-8 sm:p-12
booking_form.fields: Departure (Select), Destination (Select), Transport Type (Select), Date (DatePicker), Name (Input), Phone (Input)

why_choose_us.icon_style: w-12 h-12 text-orange-500 mb-6 bg-orange-50 p-3 rounded-xl

mobile_sticky_cta.call_btn: bg-orange-500 text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold
mobile_sticky_cta.whatsapp_btn: bg-[#25D366] text-white flex items-center justify-center gap-2 py-3 rounded-xl font-bold

hero_van.description: White passenger van on a highway (simulating the Renault Master)

service_auto.description: Auto platform / transport truck on highway

instructions_to_main_agent: Add 'Space Grotesk' and 'Manrope' fonts using Google Fonts in the HTML head. Configure Tailwind config to use them for sans.
Ensure 'lucide-react' icons are used for all icon needs (Phone, Calendar, User, Package, Car, Check, etc.). DO NOT USE EMOJIS.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-call-button', data-testid='nav-booking-link').
Hero background must use 'media.hero_van.url' with a dark overlay to ensure white text is highly readable.
Build the Routes section with a modern, clear visual hierarchy. Use a timeline/path layout if possible.
Implement the Lead-Gen Booking Form using Shadcn primitives.
Add a fixed mobile CTA at the bottom visible only on 'max-md' screens.
Add a Language Switcher component in the navigation.
Create a mock Admin Panel login/dashboard view if required by the structure, otherwise ensure marketing pages are perfectly polished.
Never use text-center for long paragraphs. Keep text aligned left for readability unless it's a short badge/label.
